items.section: 4.1 Living and non-living — a virus and a prion
items.sentence: A virus is a bounding packet of code — nucleic acid within a coat — inert apart from a host, as a spore or a seed is inert.
items.text: A virus is a bounding packet of code, nucleic acid within a coat, inert apart from a host. A seed and a spore are each a wrapped going-on, non-living at its own scale with its selves living inward. Dormancy is the bi-coupling at its own scale ceasing, and germinating is that bi-coupling opening again.
